text: Solve the wrong problem beautifully.
Remove the part you rehearsed.
Do the last step first.
Halve it. Then halve the half.
Make the transition the destination.
Let the accident audition.
Give the mistake a name and a job.
Which rule are you obeying without being asked?
Trade your best idea for your strangest one.
Work at the speed of boredom.
Copy the structure; betray the content.
End earlier than feels safe.
Abandon symmetry mid-gesture.
Describe it to someone who cannot see it. Build what you said.
Make it hospitable to strangers.
What would this be at four in the morning?
Finish it badly, then defend the flaw.
Ask the least qualified person in the room. That may be you.
Tune to the room, not the chart.
Play the chord you can't name.
Voice it in two notes.
Detune one string; keep the fingering.
Let the drums lie about the tempo.
The overtone is the melody.
Treat the amp as the instrument.
Record the rehearsal. Discard the take.
What is the silence doing?
Turn one element to zero. Notice what remains.
Hold the shot until it confesses.
Weather is a character. Cast it.
Cut on the breath, not the action.
Let the location rewrite the scene.
Show the aftermath; imply the event.
Water, smoke, or dust: choose one witness.
Light it for the room it used to be.
The frame is a door. Which way does it open?
Write the footnote first.
Steal the syntax of a prayer.
Say it once. Trust the echo.
Translate it into plain speech; keep the ghost.
Delete every sentence you're proud of. Read what's left.
Let a minor character narrate.
The obstacle is the initiation.
Descend, retrieve, return. You are on the wrong step.
Read it as a cipher for something kind.
What would the older tradition call this?
Consult the dream, then disobey it.
Cross the threshold facing backward.
